desktop.startup_failed.body.explanation: Paragraph under the heading explaining that the till program stopped right after opening.

desktop.startup_failed.detail.explanation: Label before the technical reason (for example an exit status) shown in small text for support.

desktop.startup_failed.logs.explanation: Sentence introducing the data folder path, asking the user to send the two log files from it to support. File names desktop.log and till.log stay unchanged.

desktop.startup_failed.step_reinstall.explanation: Second step in the numbered list: reinstall from the latest installer; saved data is kept. Keep the product name unchanged.

desktop.startup_failed.step_retry.explanation: First step in the numbered list: close the window and open the app again.

desktop.startup_failed.title.explanation: Heading of the window the desktop app shows when the till program stopped right after it was opened.

status.backup_copy.hint.explanation: Tooltip of the no-backup-copied chip: why and how to copy a backup off the till.

status.backup_copy.label.explanation: Status-bar chip for managers: no backup was downloaded or saved off this till in the last 7 days. Links to Settings → Backups.

status.cloud_auth.replaced.explanation:
Status-bar chip on a till the shop's owner replaced as main till on my.universaltill.com. Names the till that replaced it.

Placeholders:
- %s: the name of the new main till, or 'the new main till' when unknown

status.cloud_auth.replaced_hint.explanation:
Tooltip of the 'Replaced by' chip: when the till was replaced and that its sales go nowhere.

Placeholders:
- %[1]s: the date it was replaced (YYYY-MM-DD)
- %[2]s: the name of the new main till, or 'the new main till' when unknown

status.replaced.unnamed.explanation: Stands in for the new main till's name in the 'Replaced by' chip and banner while the cloud does not know it yet. Lower case: it sits inside a sentence.

status.replaced_banner.explanation:
Banner on every page of a till the shop's owner replaced as main till; it cannot be dismissed. Selling still works, but those sales reach neither the cloud nor the main till.

Placeholders:
- %[1]s: the name of the new main till, or 'the new main till' when unknown

status.shop_currency_mismatch.hint.explanation:
Status-bar chip title (tooltip), shown to a manager when this till's currency differs from the shop's currency on my. (the cloud portal; a product name, keep 'my.' as is) and the till did not switch by itself (it already has sales, or this till version does not know that currency). Explains both currencies and that the manager changes it in Settings.

Placeholders:
- %[1]s: the till's currency code, e.g. GBP
- %[2]s: the shop's currency code on my., e.g. EUR

status.shop_currency_mismatch.label.explanation: Status-bar chip label, shown to a manager when this till's currency differs from the shop's currency on my. Short: it sits in the status bar.

sync.quarantine_reason.single_purpose_vo.explanation: Reason column on /sync-quarantine: a journaled top-up of a single-purpose voucher (VAT fixed at issue) from an additional till was refused, so the entry is quarantined.

tills.discovery.ambient.has_sales_confir.explanation: Label of a required tick box in the 'found a main till on this network' notice and above the join tabs on the Tills page, shown only when this till already has sales. Ticking it confirms that linking (or joining with a pairing code) replaces this till's sales, products and settings with the main till's copy.

tills.discovery.ambient.has_sales_warnin.explanation: Warning in the 'found a main till on this network' notice and above the join tabs on the Tills page, shown only when this till already has sales: linking (or joining with a pairing code) replaces everything on this till with the main till's copy, and this till's own sales are not sent to the main till (a copy stays in this till's backups folder). Also the error shown when a join is attempted without ticking the confirm box.

tills.join.rejoin_note.explanation:
Note in a joined till's 'join an existing shop' section: joining another main till sends its unsent sales there first.

Placeholders:
- %d: how many unsent sales this till has

tills.join.rejoin_sales_warning.explanation: Warning above the join tabs on a till that is already joined to a main till and has sales: joining another main till replaces its data, but its unsent sales are sent there first.

tills.join_error.replaced.explanation: Join error on a till that tried to join a main till the shop's owner has replaced.

tills.join_error.unsent_day_closes.explanation:
Join error on a joined till: its day closes (Z reports) that the cloud must keep are not uploaded yet; joining would wipe them, so the join waits.

Placeholders:
- %s: how many day closes are not in the cloud yet

tills.join_error.unsent_day_closes_refus.explanation:
Join error on a joined till whose day closes cannot reach the cloud because the cloud refuses uploads (subscription not active).

Placeholders:
- %s: how many day closes are not in the cloud yet

tills.join_error.unsent_not_sent.explanation:
Join error on a joined till re-joining a (new) main till: its sales that never reached a main till could not be sent there first, so the join was refused and nothing on this till changed.

Placeholders:
- %s: how many unsent sales this till has

tills.main_unreachable_help.explanation: Only used by till line 0.34; kept while that line is supported (ADR-0160 §5).

tills.main_unreachable_help_offline.explanation: Notice on a joined till's Tills page while the main till is not answering: the till keeps selling, reconnects by itself, what to check.

tills.main_unreachable_replaced.explanation: Line in the 'main till isn't answering' notice on a joined till's Tills page: what to do when the main till was replaced, and that unsent sales go to the new main till first.

tills.pairing.error.this_till_replaced.explanation: Error on a replaced main till when a manager asks it for a pairing code for another till.
